title: LAMPS THROW COLOURED LIGHT
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. A lamp used to cut a grey hole in the darkness, and its colour showed only as two faint flat discs. Now every lamp lights the ground in its own colour: sodium posts throw amber, the FOUNDRY lamps throw cold blue, and each lamp is one smooth pool instead of two flat rings. Ground away from the lamps is exactly as dark as before, so night is no brighter and nothing about stealth or sight changes. Settings, LIGHTING: HIGH and STANDARD draw the coloured light, CLASSIC draws the old darkness exactly as it was.
now: Lamps now light the ground in their own colour, amber posts and cold blue foundry lamps, with night exactly as dark as before.
